name: ACDC: Automated Cardiac Diagnosis Challenge Dataset
description: The ACDC dataset contains cardiac cine-MRI examinations collected from 150 patients categorized into five evenly distributed groups (normal, previous myocardial infarction, dilated cardiomyopathy, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and abnormal right ventricle). Examinations include manual segmentations for left ventricular endocardium, myocardium, and right ventricular endocardium at end-diastole and end-systole.
